key_events: Nov 5: Weekly jobless claims – watch for impact on risk sentiment
Nov 6: Jobs report – stronger‑than‑expected payrolls could push risk‑off, weaker could boost risk‑on
Nov 10: CPI inflation release – watch for deviation from 2.26% expectations
macro.overnight_read: Crypto rallied after the midterm sweep (BTC up ~0.4% and ETH up ~0.3% with neutral fear/greed), while major FX pairs showed modest gains (EUR/USD +0.21%, GBP/USD +0.11%). VIX at 20.8 signals moderate volatility, and the dollar remains strong. Expect a mixed open with upside in crypto and safe‑haven assets if jobs data disappoint.
macro.summary: The market is in a choppy, range‑bound mode with moderate volatility. Keep risk appetite mid‑level and focus on core multi‑day swings in gold, BTC, ETH and major EUR/GBP pairs, while using tactical momentum around the jobs and CPI releases. Avoid high‑volatility equity bets and speculative meme‑coins. React quickly to the jobs report – a weak print favors risk‑on, a strong print pushes a defensive tilt.
